defects.description: spine=18 (forward lean) is too much. Description says "keep the torso upright and elongated". Torso flexion_deg=18° is a noticeable lean, not upright. PR-v4 auto-fix bumped spine from 14 to 18 for visibility, but this contradicts "torso upright".

Raised foot too high: leftFoot at y=+0.389 (chest level), but description says "place the foot flat against the wall at knee-to-hip height" (y between -0.05 and +0.05). Foot is 0.34m above hip — way too high. leftKnee=95° (deep bend) folds shin backward-up, putting foot above hip.

regression_risk: low — 2 fields, single-pose. Spine reduction makes torso more upright. leftKnee reduction extends shin, drops foot from chest-level toward hip-level. leftHip:75 preserved (thigh forward for leg-raise). rightHip:-3 preserved (standing leg neutral). hipAbductL:22 preserved (slight inward cross). No arm/torso rotation changes.
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: spine + = forward lean. Description explicitly says "keep the torso upright and elongated" — spine should be small (≤10°). PR-v4 bumped 14→18 for "visible threshold" but this contradicts the upright directive. Reducing to 8 restores upright intent while keeping small visibility. leftKnee:95→65 reduces knee bend so shin extends more, dropping foot from y=0.389 (chest level) toward y≈0.10-0.15 (closer to hip y=0.05). Full foot-on-wall at hip height would require hipAbduct outward (lateral abduction), but minimal change here preserves the leg-raise silhouette. Description allows "knee-to-hip height" range, so partial drop is acceptable.
